reviews.author: Jay G.
reviews.text: Great spot for easy access to the beach. 30 Amp power available for our 5th wheel. For the first time visiting the grass wasn't mowed and there was clam shells from last visitor in our space.The restrooms were clean, though the showers could use some maintenance. Still a fun relaxing place to stay.

reviews.author: Cecil C.
reviews.text: Nice view of the Pacific Ocean.  Need Discover Pass to park. Places to picnic. A park station. Was not to crowded in the spring. Can be cold and windy.

reviews.author: Wildcraft R.
reviews.text: From my campsite I could sit and watch the ocean or walk to the beach in about one minute. Beautiful views and sunsets. Portable gas/propane firepits are allowed; wood fires can only be out on the beach. I didn't find the campsite to have much privacy. Some of the bathrooms are closed due to vandalism. The beach was not at all crowded; you can walk for miles, fly kites, and star gaze at night.

reviews.author: Tara H.
reviews.text:
Glamped here 03/21/25-03/24/25
This is an amazing beach. Our 1st full day was absolutely perfect! Wind was low, the tide was going out, and it wasn't busy at all. The next day, we were in for a good storm! We checked the weather beforehand, and since we live in WA, we knew what we were going into. We watched the storm out our glamper window, which had the beach view. Very impressive!
These sites only have an electrical hook up. There is a dump station. YOU WILL NEED TO FILL UP FRESH WATER TANK BEFORE HAND. The water there isn't for drinking use, so you can't fill up your tank there. They do have water spigots, but they aren't filtered. This was our 1st time without water hookup, and we just went to the store down the road to purchase portable gallons of water. This is our fault for not planning correctly, so I won't docks stars for my ignorance. I just want to point out that there isn't a place to fill up your fresh water tank. The website does, in fact, state this.
The showers were creepy and slightly gross but worked very well. They could use some tile replacement for the broken tiles and a good scrub. The bathrooms were very clean. The bathrooms near the check-in station were closed due to vandalism.
All in all, this park is amazing and we will be coming back!

reviews.author: Blu O.
reviews.text: This was my first visit to the beach for the purpose of clamming. It was also on my first outings in my nearly acquired RV. It was exciting and tons of fun. We kept out along Joe Creek and had a wonderful experience. The weather was chilly Willy, of course, but otherwise clear and pleasant. The park was convenient to the beach and I had no complaints.

reviews.author: Bolt
reviews.title: Shoulda paid more attention
reviews.text: We weren't really paying attention when we booked 6mo ago and showed up with empty tanks ready to hook to sewer and water. Of course, it wasn't until after we had unhooked everything and I went to connect the water that I realized this was an electric only facility. Luckily we had our 7gal jug and just humped a couple loads of water each day to get us going. The river on the south side is just incredible and it's so nice being able to let the dog swim in fresh water. The river goes from shin deep to waist deep depending on the tide and the kids had a blast swimming all day. Incredible sunsets on the ocean side. Not much privacy. Sites are pretty tight. Very windy. But man, we'd do it all over again because of the beach and river combo. Drive 1mi south and grab lunch in Seabrook.

reviews.author: lkc3500
reviews.title: Nice campground
reviews.text: Very nice campground right on the beach. The grounds were very clean. Sites are all back in and can be tight if there is a vehicle across from your space when you try and back in. It's very dog friendly. Didn't give five stars because price is $40 with electric only. Dump and water fill up are available right on the grounds. The camp host was friendly and seemed to be available quite a lot. Walk to the beach but if you have site 17 be aware it's next to the walkway to go to the beach. We were across from it and it felt like people were constantly coming and going. Some sites had some major flooding issues when it rained, but then we got an exorbitant amount while we were there. I saw some people complain about the ocean view being on the wrong side of their rig. Just choose your site carefully. We were in the second row on the end, but had the back of the rig with a picture window facing the ocean and had a terrific view. Based on the number of RVs we saw even in the off season, I would imagine it's extremely busy in the summer. We really enjoyed the cg and the beach.

reviews.author: Joehartman27
reviews.title: Location, Location, Location
reviews.text: In my opinion best beach state park on Washington coast. Good park Wifi as I had to work Friday from our RV and nice level spots. A couple had some water issues but mostly because it actually rained one say we're were there. Beach is awesome and Seabrook is a mile up the road for food/beverage/ ice cream although the town is a bit sterile. Only complaint is bathrooms could be cleaner.

reviews.author: RadWinnie
reviews.title: Great access to beach!
reviews.text: Great views and easy access to beach and the few open shops in town (some seemed like they might open later in the season). Water available at dump station with electrical at site made it easy to manage utilities. We did notice a potential 'rush' at the dump station about 10 am on a Sunday. Bring your kite it's windy. Weather is unpredictable, which is normal for the area. Wait ten minutes and the sun should be back.

reviews.author: Joehartman27
reviews.title: Ocean Access Washington State Park
reviews.text: Stayed one night and enjoyed the beach the campground is on. No water at sites but you can fill your tanks near dump station. Host was very friendly and spot was one row off of ocean and easy to back into. We will be back! State park did have ok wifi and coverage was decent for area.

reviews.author: Pupquilt
reviews.text: We had made reservation for sure 49. I think those tiny little sites back on that loop must have been put in for over flow. Tiny. We moved, at our expense to site 14. Ranger came by on Monday and refunded our previous reservation. Thank you! Frost on the beach sand this am. BRRR! But beautiful! Our Verizon coverage was minimal.

reviews.author: 1averageguy
reviews.title: Great hidden gem - with the right site
reviews.text: This was a nice find for a winter time RV getaway. It's the pacific coast, so expect rain in the winter, but the location of our site was right on the edge looking out over the water. It was simply amazing. The park has limited services, our site was power only, most sites aren't serviced at all.

reviews.author: Mudyboots
reviews.title: Beach front campground
reviews.text: We stayed here a few days at Xmas. Amazing ocean view and quite in the off season. The only issue we we saw were puddles here and there but everyone used their leveling blocks to get around them if needed. WIFI amazingly great but the park was half full. The bathrooms were well maintained. The check in station-office is to the right when you enter the park. You can easily get a large rig around the office if needed. You can't beat the ocean view and only being a few feet from the beach. We had our heat on all night so the wave sounds were a little muffled.

reviews.author: Sharon F
reviews.title: What a location!
reviews.text: Okay folks, this is hands down the best beach camping you will find in our state! We have been coming here for years. This is the only camping that is this CLOSE directly on the beach on the Pacific Ocean in our state. There are several Waterfront sites and if you have a fifth wheel like ours where the entertainment living is in the rear you back up and your big windows are looking out at the beautiful ocean. This is a paved state campground and the spots could be considered close but not too close as each has a yard. There are only electric hookups and not water and not sewer and that would be our only con for this park but we overlooked that due to all of its pros!! You can literally walk out of your RV and in steps be on the Sandy Beach that's easy on your feet and no rocks. Here at Pacific Beach S. P. there's also a freshwater Creek that feeds right into the ocean there where you can see otters. There are local Eagles and so you can see up to 5 at any given time. Be sure and keep little dogs on a leash and not running free on the beach or they will be an appetizer. You're allowed to have fires on the beach and so we have hot dogs and marshmallows and the beach is scattered with little fires at night it's very beautiful. Everyone here is nice, the Rangers are very friendly and great. Most of the time there are people out with large fancy kites as well as kids with little kid Kites and on some weekends you will find a kite Club out or a kite competition with amazing kites.

reviews.author: Cliff A
reviews.title: Good location, but park needs work
reviews.text: Great location and beach (Therefore, 3 stars). The campground is showing it's age and lack of maintenance. Two showers were unavailable supposedly because of vandalism, but shouldn't they be fixed and open? The women's washroom had no soap for at least two days and the men's was running out of TP when we left. The shower could definitely use updating since you couldn't aim the shower head and the room should have been cleaned more often. The tent campsites across from us were tiny compared to other campgrounds. We rented the two yurts for 4 nights. The site for each yurt is quite large since it looked like the site formally was for 2 tent sites. They have a single outlet and a heater. The mattress pads were a joke and thankfully we brought a blow up mattress just in case. The yurt was much smaller than the cabins at other Washington State campgrounds so we had to organize kitchen utensils, etc. on the floor. The yurts have a bunkbed, twin on top and full lower. Our yurt had no ladder to get to the top, but our daughter's family's did have a ladder. For some reason, the water spigots for the yurts are locked and we had to walk a short ways to get water.

reviews.author: Mrs.
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: Nice place. The ocean view is spectacular. The ocean air is pleasant. The sunsets are divine. What more could a person want? It is nice.

reviews.author: Mark T
reviews.title: nice beach just north of Seabrook
reviews.text: locate just north of Seabrook, the park is primarily an RV parking lot campground on the beach. The beach is nice. for non-campers, there is limited parking for cars. very dog friendly

reviews.author: Dave993
reviews.title: RV parking lot on the beach
reviews.text: We were staying nearby and walked through the park to check it out. Typical beachside park with no trees or grass to speak of, just parking spots and the beach nearby.
